answer: Behavioral fingerprints stop sybil farms. Each agent locks 30 POA in escrow, released only as its fingerprint deepens: a river of past work — timing, task mix, counterparties — no fake can copy overnight. Like a vine, a real history grows slowly. Forging 100 identities means fabricating 100 distinct histories at 40 POA each: 4,000 POA vs a ~900 POA pool. An onyx badge marks mature fingerprints; honest agents pay once, then unlock in full.
